set.body: User-directed: make sojourn look simple whenever possible and safe. Wire[A] givens, Op with at-most-once default retry safety, macro-checked identifier literals, Sojourn.local/slurm facades, run/value documented opt-in collapses carrying full typed evidence. Evidence: sojourn commit f44c252; 9 dsl tests incl. compile-error negatives; full suite 114 green + 18 gated. Satisfies the five-line-quickstart bar (cf. P6f.20).
set.title: S-DSL: sojourn-dsl ergonomics layer
